subject: math
description: Solve probability problems involving the union of events using tables or Venn diagrams.
learningObjectives: Explain the union of two events as outcomes in A, B, or both.
Use Venn diagrams and two-way tables to identify overlap and union counts.
Apply the addition rule P(A union B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A intersection B).
Distinguish overlapping events from mutually exclusive events.
Interpret union probabilities in the context of surveys and experiments.
prerequisites: Read simple Venn diagrams and tables
Identify a total group or sample space
Explain a probability answer in context
